name: Mistral Small 4 (119B A6B)
purpose: A hybrid model that combines instruct, reasoning (formerly Magistral) and Devstral capabilities; reasoning is set per request with reasoning_effort.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Repo has no LICENSE file; the card links the apache.org text and says 'Open-source license for both commercial and non-commercial use'. Text read: standard Apache License 2.0 text (identical to https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt, read 2026-11-19).

architecture.why_this_design: Card: unifies three previously separate families (Instruct, Reasoning formerly Magistral, and Devstral) in one hybrid model with per-request reasoning effort; the efficient MoE design gives a 40 percent lower end-to-end completion time in a latency-optimized setup and 3x more requests per second in a throughput-optimized setup versus Mistral Small 3. An EAGLE head and an NVFP4 checkpoint are released for speed.

pc-16gb.variant: UD-IQ2_XXS 34.9 GB or UD-Q3_K_S 49.6 GB with experts in RAM
pc-16gb.notes: 6.5 B active but 2-3 bit quality unmeasured.

mac-64gb+.notes: 64 GB working set 51-53 GB: IQ3 class.

engine_support.notes: Unsloth GGUFs exist; Tona has no module.

benchmarks.name: AA-LCR (long context)
benchmarks.variant: with reasoning, about 1.6K characters of output

strengths: European-language focus (24 languages listed, German named)
Native function calling and JSON output; reasoning_effort per request
Vendor claims LiveCodeBench above gpt-oss-120b with about 20% less output
weaknesses: GPQA 71.2 is clearly below Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (84.2) and Gemma 4 26B-A4B (82.3) on vendor numbers
74 GB at Q4_K_M: the large file buys no visible quality gain on the card
soft.behavior: reasoning_effort high: T=0.7; none: T 0.0-0.7 depending on task; example scripts use 0.1.
best_for: German and French assistant work on 96 GB+ memory machines
soft.maturity: Mistral AI: European vendor with a regular release cadence (Large 3 and 4, Medium 3.5, Leanstral).

user_reports.summary: When used in Mistral Vibe or opencode the model often answers just "Task completed" without doing the task; the reporter finds it otherwise more concise and better at code than Devstral. A commenter got it stable in opencode with a Q5_K_M quant on ik_llama but calls the Vibe setup a disaster.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 (text read), vendor claim of unified instruct, reasoning and coding in one model with Mistral German strength, but 119B total (about 70 GB at 4 bit) limits it to 64 GB+ machines, the independent German index lists no Small 4 entry (only Mistral Large 4 preview: INCLUDE DE 83.2, GermEval 79.9), and agent-loop reports are mixed. Missing Tona module is only a blocker.
blockers: no Mistral Small 4 module in Tona

sources.note: Apache-2.0 text linked from the card
